beats.event: Wealthy bachelor Bingley rents Netherfield next to the Bennets
At the Meryton assembly Darcy calls Elizabeth 'not handsome enough'
Bingley courts Jane; Darcy quietly finds himself drawn to Elizabeth
Officer Wickham tells Elizabeth Darcy cheated him of a living
Elizabeth refuses Mr Collins; Charlotte Lucas accepts him instead
Bingley leaves Netherfield; Jane's hopes collapse
Elizabeth visits Charlotte at Hunsford; meets Lady Catherine
At Hunsford Darcy proposes; she angrily rejects him
Darcy's letter explains Wickham's true character and his role separating Bingley from Jane
Elizabeth reconsiders; grows ashamed of her prejudice
Touring Pemberley she meets Darcy again; his manners have softened
News: Lydia has eloped with Wickham; the family faces ruin
The pair are married in London; the scandal contained
Aunt Gardiner reveals Darcy secretly paid Wickham off to save Lydia
Lady Catherine demands Elizabeth promise never to marry Darcy; she refuses
Darcy proposes again at Longbourn; Elizabeth accepts
Double wedding of Jane to Bingley and Elizabeth to Darcy
